blocks.text: There is an obvious, almost frustrating divide happening in the music industry today. I have noticed this shift over the years, and it is something that many music fans can relate to. On one hand, we have a growing list of modern artists who look at the concert stage not as a place to perform their songs, but as a literal lecture hall. They treat paying ticket-buyers as a captive audience that needs to be schooled on what to believe and how to think.
